title: CodeScout: An Effective Recipe for Reinforcement Learning of Code Search Agents
venue: ACM CAIS 2026 Workshop on Agentic Software Engineering (non-archival)
authors_zh: Lintang Sutawika、Aditya Bharat Soni、Bharath Sriraam R R、Apurva Gandhi、Taha Yassine、Sanidhya Vijayvargiya、Yuchen Li、Xuhui Zhou、Yilin Zhang、Leander Melroy Maben、Graham Neubig
paper_type_zh: 代码搜索 agent 的在线 RL rollout 数据发布与可验证奖励构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究多次 rollout、代码定位 verifier、失败轨迹保留、异步 RLVR、训练预算核对与 agent 轨迹可重放性的读者
one_line: Releases 54,845 full terminal-search RL rollouts for CodeScout-14B and CodeScout-4B, preserving grouped attempts, component localization rewards, and 8,281 zero-reward failures rather than publishing only successful trajectories.
CodeScout 发布 54,845 条 CodeScout-14B 与 CodeScout-4B 的完整终端代码搜索 RL rollout，保留多次尝试、分层定位奖励和 8,281 条零奖励失败轨迹；但公开行数超过论文名义预算，部分分组不完整，且数据许可与精确重放谱系仍为 unknown。
why: It exposes how repository-search attempts, a patch-derived terminal verifier, multiple rollouts, and asynchronous GSPO interact, while the count mismatch, incomplete groups, missing replay lineage, and absent data license show exactly what an auditable agent-trajectory release still needs.
inclusion_reason: CodeScout releases a rare auditable RL agent data object: grouped repository-search attempts with full terminal conversations, structured terminal predictions, component rewards, training-step indices, and both successful and zero-reward siblings, making rollout retention, verifier design, training budgets, and replay gaps directly inspectable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
CodeScout addresses a narrow but consequential data problem in reinforcement learning for software-engineering agents: a repository-search policy needs repeated, inspectable attempts and an automatic signal about whether it localized the code implicated by an issue. A final patch test can verify a repair, but it is expensive and confounds search with editing, dependency installation, and execution. Conversely, a single best trajectory hides how often the policy fails, how alternative attempts differ, and which terminal contract generated the learning signal.

The paper converts Python issue-resolution tasks from SWE-Smith into code-localization environments. The agent receives an issue description and a known repository path, searches a faulty pre-PR repository with a Unix terminal, and ends with one structured LocalizationFinish call. Gold targets are extracted from the issue's resolution patch at file, module/class, and function/method levels. Dependencies are not installed and tests are not run: this is localization, not repair verification.

The official rollout release is the main data object considered here. Each of its 54,845 rows records instance_id, training step, rollout_number, a full tool-using chat, tool definitions, and terminal reward components. It contains 39,040 CodeScout-14B rows and 15,805 CodeScout-4B rows. The conversations retain terminal commands and observations, while the reward dictionary exposes file-, module-, and entity-level F1 components, their sum, and a multiturn field.

This object belongs exactly in Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because repeated attempts, their group structure, their terminal scores, and the treatment of rejected or unsuccessful samples are first-class data properties. The release keeps 8,281 zero-localization-reward rows (15.10%), not only successful outputs, and many task-step groups contain both zero and positive attempts. That makes the artifact useful for failure and selection audits even though it is online training data rather than a test-time search benchmark.

The release is not fully replayable. Its 54,845 rows exceed the paper-side nominal 4B+14B budget of 51,200 by 3,645; six 4B groups are incomplete; current launch-script defaults disagree with the paper; and rows omit gold targets, repository commits, policy checkpoints, seeds, stop reasons, loss masks, and sampling logprobs. The Card therefore preserves partial status and L4: the paper and pinned artifacts support a detailed bilingual account, but count provenance, licenses, and exact replay remain unresolved.

CodeScout 处理软件工程 agent 强化学习中一个范围明确但后果重要的数据问题：仓库搜索策略既需要多次、可检查的尝试，也需要自动判断其是否定位到 issue 所涉及代码的信号。最终补丁测试可以验证修复，却成本较高，并把搜索与编辑、依赖安装和执行混在一起；只发布一条最佳轨迹则会隐藏策略失败频率、不同尝试之间的差异，以及产生学习信号的终点契约。

论文把 SWE-Smith 中的 Python issue-resolution 任务转换为代码定位环境。agent 获得 issue 描述和已知仓库路径，使用 Unix terminal 搜索处于修复前故障状态的仓库，并以一次结构化 LocalizationFinish 调用结束。gold target 从 issue 的修复 patch 中抽取，分为文件、module/class 和 function/method 三层。流程不安装依赖，也不运行测试：任务是定位，而不是修复验证。

本 Card 关注的核心数据对象是官方 rollout 发布。其 54,845 行中的每一行都记录 instance_id、训练 step、rollout_number、完整工具调用对话、工具定义和终点奖励分量。其中包括 39,040 条 CodeScout-14B 行与 15,805 条 CodeScout-4B 行。对话保留 terminal 命令和 observation，奖励字典公开文件、module、entity 三层 F1、三者之和以及 multiturn 字段。

该对象准确属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为多次尝试、分组结构、终点评分，以及对被拒绝或失败样本的处理，都是一等数据属性。发布保留 8,281 条零定位奖励行（15.10%），而非只保留成功输出；许多 task-step 组同时包含零分和正分尝试。因此，即使它是在线训练数据而不是测试时搜索 benchmark，该 artifact 仍适合用于失败与选择审计。

发布物并不能完整重放。54,845 行比论文中 4B+14B 的名义预算 51,200 多 3,645 行；六个 4B 分组不完整；当前启动脚本默认值与论文不一致；逐行数据还缺少 gold target、仓库 commit、策略 checkpoint、随机种子、停止原因、loss mask 和采样 logprob。因此本 Card 保持 partial 状态与 L4：论文和固定版本 artifact 足以支持细致的双语说明，但行数来源、许可证和精确重放仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution in one sentence is: turn patch-derived code locations into a deterministic terminal verifier, use it to train terminal-search agents with repeated online rollouts, and publish the resulting full conversations—including failed siblings—rather than only a filtered success set.

The data/feedback object has four coupled layers. First, an issue and repository state define a search environment. Second, the current policy produces a terminal-tool trajectory with commands such as rg, find, ls, grep, and sed, plus observations. Third, LocalizationFinish serializes predicted locations as objects with required file and optional class_name and function_name fields. Fourth, a programmatic verifier compares predicted and patch-derived gold sets and records scalar reward components.

The localization reward is \[ R_{\mathrm{loc}} = F1_{\mathrm{file}} + F1_{\mathrm{module}} + F1_{\mathrm{entity}}, \] so it ranges from 0 to 3. In the release, the components are named file_reward, module_reward, and entity_reward, and their sum is multilevel_localization_f1_reward. CodeScout-14B also uses an independent binary multiturn_reward: it is 1 only when the rollout uses exactly four turns. The released dictionary stores the components separately rather than a top-level training total.

The terminal contract is stricter than "mention a plausible file." The generator expects exactly one valid LocalizationFinish action and applies last-step sanity checks; missing, duplicated, malformed, or co-issued finish calls receive zero localization reward. A rollout that reaches the maximum turn count without finishing is also loss-masked during training, although its zero-reward conversation may remain in the public artifact. No human annotator, learned judge, test execution, or process reward model grades intermediate steps.

The repeated-attempt release is as important as the verifier. CodeScout-14B has 9,760 groups of exactly four rows. CodeScout-4B has 1,979 instance-step groups: 1,973 contain eight rows, while six contain respectively 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 rows. Within the 14B data, 1,448 groups mix zero and positive localization outcomes; the 4B data has 869 such mixed groups. These siblings permit comparisons that a success-only corpus would erase.

This Card keeps the direct 4B/14B RL artifact separate from the paper's 1.7B path. For the latter, CodeScout-14B samples 7.7K tasks and only trajectories perfect at all three localization levels are retained, yielding 4K rejection-sampling fine-tuning examples before 1.7B RL on 800 disjoint tasks. The checked CodeScout_Training_Rollouts release contains no 1.7B configuration and should not be described as that filtered RFT set.

贡献可以概括为一句话：把 patch 衍生的代码位置变成确定性的终点 verifier，用它通过多次在线 rollout 训练 terminal-search agent，并发布由此产生的完整对话——包括失败的同组轨迹——而不是只给出经过筛选的成功集。

数据/反馈对象由四个相互连接的层次组成。第一，issue 与仓库状态定义搜索环境。第二，当前策略产生 terminal-tool 轨迹，其中包含 rg、find、ls、grep、sed 等命令及 observation。第三，LocalizationFinish 把预测位置序列化为对象列表，每个对象必须有 file，并可选 class_name 与 function_name。第四，程序化 verifier 比较预测集合与从 patch 抽取的 gold set，并记录标量奖励分量。

定位奖励为 \[ R_{\mathrm{loc}} = F1_{\mathrm{file}} + F1_{\mathrm{module}} + F1_{\mathrm{entity}}, \] 取值范围为 0 到 3。在发布中，三个分量名为 file_reward、module_reward 和 entity_reward，总和记录为 multilevel_localization_f1_reward。CodeScout-14B 还使用独立的二值 multiturn_reward：只有 rollout 恰好使用四轮时才为 1。公开 reward dictionary 分别存储这些分量，没有给出顶层训练总奖励字段。

终点契约比“提到一个看似合理的文件”更严格。生成器要求恰好出现一次有效 LocalizationFinish 动作，并进行最后一步 sanity check；缺失、重复、格式错误或与其他动作同时发出的 finish 调用都会得到零定位奖励。达到最大轮数仍未结束的 rollout 在训练中还会被 loss-mask，不过其零奖励对话可能继续保留在公开 artifact 中。中间步骤不由人工标注者、学习式 judge、测试执行或 process reward model 评分。

多次尝试发布与 verifier 本身同样重要。CodeScout-14B 有 9,760 个严格包含四行的分组。CodeScout-4B 有 1,979 个 instance-step 组：其中 1,973 个含八行，另有六个分别只含 1、2、3、4、5、6 行。14B 数据中有 1,448 个组同时出现零分与正分定位结果；4B 数据中这样的 mixed group 有 869 个。这些同组轨迹支持成功集无法提供的对照。

本 Card 严格区分直接用于 4B/14B RL 的 artifact 与论文中的 1.7B 路径。对于后者，CodeScout-14B 在 7.7K 个任务上采样，只保留三层定位均为满分的轨迹，得到 4K 条 rejection-sampling fine-tuning 样本；随后在与之不重叠的 800 个任务上进行 1.7B RL。已检查的 CodeScout_Training_Rollouts 发布没有 1.7B 配置，不能把它称作该成功筛选 RFT 集。

title: Method
方法
html:
Task sourcing and gold extraction. CodeScout begins from SWE-Smith issue-resolution instances. The paper reports a filtered pool of about 39K Python issues across 128 repositories; the pinned processed task artifact contains 39,287 rows. Processing excludes pull requests that create or delete files, drops empty issue descriptions, and ignores non-Python targets. The gold patch is parsed into modified files, modules/classes, and functions/methods. The authors extend LocAgent-style parsing to cover added members and class attributes, imports and global variables, while ignoring docstring-only edits.

Environment and agent interface. Each task supplies a faulty repository state before the resolution pull request. The processed SWE-Smith build path applies the bug-inducing patch, after which OpenHands-Bash exposes a Unix terminal at a known repository path. The agent searches with ordinary command-line tools; the paper reports ripgrep 15.1.0. Project dependencies are not installed and tests are not executed. The structured LocalizationFinish tool submits one or more file locations, optionally refined to class and function names.

Validity and reward. A prediction must contain exactly one parseable finish action and pass path/location sanity checks. The verifier computes set precision and recall at three granularities and converts each to F1; empty or invalid submissions receive zero. The sum of file, module, and entity F1 is in [0,3]. CodeScout-14B adds one reward point for exactly four turns, independently of localization correctness. This auxiliary term encourages a particular interaction length, but it does not make the terminal localization label process-level supervision.

Direct 4B and 14B rollout generation. CodeScout-4B starts from Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. CodeScout-14B starts from Qwen3-14B with thinking disabled and a modified chat template. Both sample at temperature 1.0 under an asynchronous SkyRL/OpenHands pipeline. Paper-side 4B training uses 200 steps, batch size 8, eight rollouts per instance, 40K context, and six turns. Paper-side 14B training uses 300 steps, batch size 32, four rollouts per instance, 50K context with YaRN, and four turns.

Optimization scaffold. The method uses modified asynchronous GSPO with sequence-level importance ratios and allows rollout policies to be up to four optimizer steps stale. It omits a KL term, entropy loss, and advantage standard-deviation normalization. Reported shared settings include AdamW, constant learning rate \(10^{-6}\), clipping bounds \(3\times10^{-4}\) and \(4\times10^{-4}\), one update epoch per batch, and eight H100 GPUs. In-progress inference is terminated after weight synchronization; maximum-step, no-finish rollouts have their policy-loss mask set to zero.

Separate 1.7B RFT/RL path. CodeScout-14B samples trajectories on 7.7K random training instances. Only trajectories with file, module, and entity F1 all equal to 1 are retained, producing 4K RFT examples. Qwen3-1.7B is fine-tuned for one epoch and then receives RL on 800 disjoint instances, using 100 steps, batch size 8, eight rollouts, 32K context, and four turns. These 1.7B rollouts are not in the checked public training-rollout release.

Published layout. The official Hugging Face artifact has two configurations and two one-file train splits: CodeScout_14B/train-00000-of-00001.parquet with 39,040 rows and CodeScout_4B/train-00000-of-00001.parquet with 15,805. Top-level fields are instance_id, reward_dict, chat_messages, step, and rollout_number. Conversations contain role/content blocks, tool calls and IDs, plus tool schemas. Rows do not contain repository URL, exact commit, applied patch, gold targets, checkpoint SHA, seed, token count, stop reason, loss mask, logprobs, or error category.

Version and configuration audit. The inspected code is commit 34789dcb21cc9e6595c2d27ad832f69ab146006f; the rollout release is commit 65a3599683b901be691621f9eab7cd932a9a2c5f. Current scripts do not directly reproduce the paper settings: the 14B script defaults to eight rollouts and six turns rather than four/four, while the 4B script defaults to ten turns rather than six. Although Hydra overrides can change some values, the exact paper launch commands have not been published.

任务来源与 gold 抽取。 CodeScout 从 SWE-Smith 的 issue-resolution 实例出发。论文报告经过筛选的任务池约含 39K 个 Python issue，覆盖 128 个仓库；固定版本的官方预处理任务 artifact 实有 39,287 行。处理流程排除会创建或删除文件的 pull request，删除空 issue 描述，并忽略非 Python target。gold patch 被解析为修改过的文件、module/class 与 function/method。作者扩展了 LocAgent 风格的解析逻辑，以覆盖新增成员和 class attribute、import 与全局变量，并忽略只修改 docstring 的情况。

环境与 agent 接口。 每个任务提供修复 pull request 之前的故障仓库状态；SWE-Smith 预处理构建路径会应用 bug-inducing patch。随后 OpenHands-Bash 在已知仓库路径上提供 Unix terminal。agent 使用常规命令行工具搜索，论文报告的 ripgrep 版本为 15.1.0。流程不安装项目依赖，也不运行测试。结构化 LocalizationFinish 工具提交一个或多个文件位置，并可细化到 class 与 function 名称。

有效性与奖励。 预测必须恰好包含一次可解析的 finish 动作，并通过路径/位置 sanity check。verifier 在三个粒度上计算集合 precision 和 recall，再转为 F1；空提交或无效提交得零分。文件、module 与 entity F1 之和位于 [0,3]。CodeScout-14B 对恰好四轮的轨迹额外加 1，这与定位正确性相互独立。该辅助项鼓励特定交互长度，但不会把终点定位标签变成 process-level supervision。

直接 4B 与 14B rollout 生成。 CodeScout-4B 从 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 开始；CodeScout-14B 从关闭 thinking 并修改 chat template 的 Qwen3-14B 开始。二者都在异步 SkyRL/OpenHands 流程中以温度 1.0 采样。论文侧 4B 训练使用 200 步、batch size 8、每实例八条 rollout、40K context 和六轮；14B 训练使用 300 步、batch size 32、每实例四条 rollout、带 YaRN 的 50K context 和四轮。

优化 scaffold。 方法使用修改后的异步 GSPO 和 sequence-level importance ratio，允许 rollout policy 最多落后四个优化步。它不使用 KL 项、entropy loss，也不进行 advantage 标准差归一化。共同设置包括 AdamW、恒定学习率 \(10^{-6}\)、\(3\times10^{-4}\) 与 \(4\times10^{-4}\) 的 clipping bounds、每批一个 update epoch，以及八张 H100。权重同步后会终止仍在进行的 inference；达到最大步数但没有 finish 的 rollout，其 policy-loss mask 被设为零。

独立的 1.7B RFT/RL 路径。 CodeScout-14B 在随机选择的 7.7K 个训练实例上采样，只保留文件、module、entity 三层 F1 均为 1 的轨迹，得到 4K 条 RFT 样本。Qwen3-1.7B 先 fine-tune 一个 epoch，再在 800 个不重叠实例上进行 RL，配置为 100 步、batch size 8、八条 rollout、32K context 和四轮。已检查的公开训练 rollout 发布不包含这些 1.7B 轨迹。

公开布局。 官方 Hugging Face artifact 包含两个 configuration 与两个单文件 train split：CodeScout_14B/train-00000-of-00001.parquet 有 39,040 行，CodeScout_4B/train-00000-of-00001.parquet 有 15,805 行。顶层字段为 instance_id、reward_dict、chat_messages、step 和 rollout_number。对话包含 role/content block、tool call 与 ID，以及 tool schema。逐行数据没有仓库 URL、精确 commit、应用的 patch、gold target、checkpoint SHA、随机种子、token 数、停止原因、loss mask、logprob 或错误类别。

版本与配置审计。 已检查代码固定在 commit 34789dcb21cc9e6595c2d27ad832f69ab146006f，rollout 发布固定在 commit 65a3599683b901be691621f9eab7cd932a9a2c5f。当前脚本不能直接复现论文设置：14B 脚本默认八条 rollout 与六轮，而论文为四条/四轮；4B 脚本默认十轮，而论文为六轮。尽管 Hydra override 可以改变部分参数，论文实验的精确启动命令仍未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Release evidence. The strongest evidence in this Card is not a benchmark score but the pinned public data itself. Both Parquet footers and the Hugging Face dataset endpoints agree on 54,845 rows: 39,040 CodeScout-14B and 15,805 CodeScout-4B. Every released row has the documented five-field top-level schema, and the reward dictionary exposes localization totals and components. These counts and scalar columns were audited over the complete release, not extrapolated from viewer samples.

Attempt structure. The 14B configuration contains 9,760 unique instance_id/step groups, each with exactly four rows and rollout_number 0–3. The 4B configuration contains 1,979 groups over 1,640 unique task IDs. Of those groups, 1,973 contain eight attempts; the remaining six contain 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 rows. This verifies that the release normally preserves the paper's repeated-attempt structure, while also demonstrating incomplete group logging that is not explained by a public manifest.

Failure retention and group diversity. Across both configurations, 8,281 rows have zero localization reward and 46,564 have a positive reward. The 14B release has 5,047 zero rows and 33,993 positive rows; 4B has 3,234 zero and 12,571 positive. At group level, 14B has 1,448 mixed zero/positive groups, 639 all-zero groups, and 7,673 all-positive groups. The corresponding 4B counts are 869 mixed, 106 all-zero, and 1,004 all-positive. Thus the artifact is demonstrably not a best-of-\(n\) or success-only dataset.

Reward distribution. For CodeScout-14B, mean localization reward is 2.04919, with 17,608 rows at the perfect value 3.0. Component means are 0.82059 for file, 0.68350 for module, and 0.54511 for entity. Its separate turn term is 1 for 34,818 rows and 0 for 4,222. For CodeScout-4B, mean localization reward is 1.84886, with 6,185 perfect rows; component means are 0.75195, 0.60553, and 0.49139. Its multiturn_reward field is present but zero for all 15,805 rows, consistent with the 4B configuration not using the 14B exact-four-turn auxiliary reward.

Budget reconciliation evidence. Paper settings imply \(300\times32\times4=38{,}400\) nominal 14B rollouts and \(200\times8\times8=12{,}800\) nominal 4B rollouts, or 51,200 total. The public release instead has 39,040 and 15,805 rows, respectively—3,645 more in total. At group level, this is 160 more 14B groups than the nominal 9,600 and 379 more 4B groups than the nominal 1,600, with the six incomplete groups included. The arithmetic is verified; the cause—retries, restarts, evaluations, duplicates, or some other logging path—is unknown.

Paper and implementation evidence. The paper and code align on the patch-derived three-level F1 verifier, structured finish action, asynchronous GSPO scaffold, and loss-masking of no-finish maximum-step rollouts. The pinned repository also fixes SkyRL and OpenHands SDK commits. However, current 14B and 4B script defaults do not match the paper's rollout/turn settings, and README_Training.md does not provide an end-to-end immutable replay procedure. This supports a construction recipe, not exact reproduction of the reported runs.

Outcome evidence boundary. The paper reports that CodeScout models improve code-localization performance on SWE-Bench Verified, Lite, and the Python subset of Pro. Those are author-reported model results and were not independently reproduced in this curation. They demonstrate that the recipe was used in training, but they do not prove that every released row is correctly attributed, legally reusable, uncontaminated, or sufficient for replay. The data-quality assessment therefore rests on schema, counts, reward semantics, lineage, and release completeness rather than benchmark gains.

发布证据。 本 Card 中最强的证据不是 benchmark 分数，而是固定版本的公开数据本身。两个 Parquet footer 与 Hugging Face dataset endpoint 均给出 54,845 行：其中 39,040 条 CodeScout-14B，15,805 条 CodeScout-4B。每个公开行都符合五字段顶层 schema，reward dictionary 公开定位总分与各分量。这些计数和标量列来自对完整发布的审计，而不是从 viewer 样本外推。

尝试结构。 14B configuration 含 9,760 个唯一 instance_id/step 分组，每组严格四行，rollout_number 为 0–3。4B configuration 含 1,979 个分组，覆盖 1,640 个唯一 task ID。其中 1,973 组包含八次尝试；其余六组分别只有 1、2、3、4、5、6 行。这既证明发布通常保留了论文中的多次尝试结构，也直接显示存在公开 manifest 未解释的不完整分组。

失败保留与组内差异。 两个 configuration 合计有 8,281 行定位奖励为零，46,564 行为正。14B 有 5,047 条零分和 33,993 条正分；4B 有 3,234 条零分和 12,571 条正分。在分组层面，14B 有 1,448 个零分/正分 mixed group、639 个全零组和 7,673 个全正组；4B 对应为 869、106 和 1,004。由此可直接确认，该 artifact 不是 best-of-\(n\) 或成功样本专用数据集。

奖励分布。 CodeScout-14B 的平均定位奖励为 2.04919，其中 17,608 行达到满分 3.0；文件、module、entity 分量均值分别为 0.82059、0.68350、0.54511。独立 turn 项有 34,818 行为 1，4,222 行为 0。CodeScout-4B 的平均定位奖励为 1.84886，6,185 行满分；三个分量均值分别为 0.75195、0.60553、0.49139。4B 的 multiturn_reward 字段虽然存在，但 15,805 行全部为零，与 4B 配置不使用 14B 的四轮辅助奖励一致。

预算核对证据。 论文设置意味着 14B 名义 rollout 数为 \(300\times32\times4=38{,}400\)，4B 为 \(200\times8\times8=12{,}800\)，总计 51,200。公开发布却分别有 39,040 与 15,805 行，合计 多 3,645 行。在分组层面，14B 比名义 9,600 组多 160 组，4B 比名义 1,600 组多 379 组，其中包括六个不完整组。算术关系已经核验；原因究竟是 retry、restart、evaluation、duplicate 还是其他日志路径，仍为 unknown。

论文与实现证据。 论文和代码在 patch 衍生的三层 F1 verifier、结构化 finish 动作、异步 GSPO scaffold，以及最大步数未 finish 轨迹的 loss mask 方面一致。固定版本仓库还固定了 SkyRL 与 OpenHands SDK commit。但当前 14B/4B 脚本默认的 rollout/turn 设置与论文不符，README_Training.md 也没有端到端的不可变重放流程。因此，现有材料支持 construction recipe，却不足以支持报告实验的精确复现。

结果证据边界。 论文报告 CodeScout 模型在 SWE-Bench Verified、Lite 和 Pro 的 Python 子集上提升代码定位表现。这些是作者报告的模型结果，本次整理没有独立复现。它们说明该配方被用于训练，但不能证明每个发布行的归因正确、具备合法复用权、没有污染或足以重放。因此，数据质量判断基于 schema、计数、奖励语义、谱系与发布完整性，而不是 benchmark 增益。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
CodeScout's novelty for this atlas is not that terminal search, patch parsing, F1, or reinforcement learning is individually new. It is the combination of a lightweight repository-localization environment, a multi-granularity programmatic terminal verifier, repeated current-policy attempts, and a public full-chat release that preserves both successful and zero-reward siblings.

Relative to repair-oriented agent data, the task deliberately stops before code editing and test execution. This reduces environment setup cost and isolates search behavior, but also narrows what the reward certifies: matching locations modified by the gold patch is not the same as producing a correct repair. The LocalizationFinish schema makes terminal predictions machine-checkable at file, class/module, and function/entity levels without claiming step-level reasoning validity.

Relative to success-filtered rejection-sampling corpora, the direct 4B/14B artifact keeps negative outcomes. The 8,281 zero-reward rows, 2,317 mixed groups across the two configurations, and 745 all-zero groups expose within-task variation and repeated failure. The separate 1.7B RFT stage is conventional success filtering and should be analyzed separately; the novelty of the public training-rollout artifact lies in not collapsing its direct-RL evidence to the perfect subset.

Relative to papers that describe online rollouts but publish only prompts or aggregate curves, CodeScout releases the full terminal conversation plus decomposed terminal reward. This permits command-level behavior analysis, reward-component studies, and attempt-group comparisons. However, it stops short of a replay-grade ledger because the chat is not joined to exact repository state, gold target, policy checkpoint, seed, stop reason, or loss mask.

The auxiliary exact-four-turn term also makes the feedback contract inspectable as a composition rather than a single opaque score. Researchers can separate localization evidence from interaction-length shaping in the released fields. At the same time, because a turn bonus can be positive independently of localization correctness, it should not be treated as stronger verification or as proof that a four-turn search is efficient.

For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, the most useful conceptual contribution is that failed and mixed attempt groups are releaseable research objects. They allow audit questions about selection, gradient exposure, verifier failure, and rollout budget that cannot be answered from final checkpoints or best-only traces. The paper's benchmark performance does not establish this novelty; the published schema and verified row/group distributions do.

CodeScout 对本图谱的创新点，并不是 terminal search、patch 解析、F1 或强化学习中的任何一项单独成立。关键在于把轻量仓库定位环境、多粒度程序化终点 verifier、当前策略的多次尝试，以及同时保留成功与零奖励同组轨迹的完整对话发布组合起来。

相对于面向修复的 agent 数据，该任务刻意停在代码编辑和测试执行之前。这样可以降低环境搭建成本并隔离搜索行为，但也缩窄了奖励所认证的内容：命中 gold patch 修改过的位置，不等于产生正确修复。LocalizationFinish schema 让文件、class/module、function/entity 三层终点预测可被机器检查，却不声称中间推理逐步有效。

相对于成功筛选的 rejection-sampling 语料，直接 4B/14B artifact 保留负面结果。8,281 条零奖励行、两个 configuration 合计 2,317 个 mixed group 和 745 个全零组，公开了同一任务内的差异与重复失败。独立的 1.7B RFT 阶段属于常见的成功筛选，必须分开分析；公开训练 rollout artifact 的特色在于没有把直接 RL 的证据压缩为满分子集。

相对于只描述在线 rollout 却只发布 prompt 或 aggregate curve 的论文，CodeScout 提供完整 terminal conversation 与分解后的终点奖励，从而支持命令级行为分析、奖励分量研究与尝试组对比。但它仍没有达到 replay-grade ledger，因为对话没有连接到精确仓库状态、gold target、策略 checkpoint、随机种子、停止原因或 loss mask。

精确四轮辅助项还让反馈契约可以按组成部分审计，而不是只看到一个不透明总分。研究者可以通过公开字段把定位证据与交互长度 shaping 分离。与此同时，turn bonus 可以在定位错误时独立为正，因而不能被当作更强的 verification，也不能证明四轮搜索一定高效。

对于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，最有价值的概念贡献是：失败与 mixed attempt group 本身就是可发布的研究对象。它们允许研究选择、梯度暴露、verifier 失败和 rollout 预算等问题，而这些问题无法从最终 checkpoint 或 best-only 轨迹回答。论文 benchmark 表现并不能建立这一新意；真正的依据是已发布 schema 与核验过的行/组分布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Proxy target and verifier boundary. Gold locations are derived from code modified by the resolution patch. This is an auditable proxy, not a complete definition of all code relevant to understanding an issue: necessary but unmodified context may be absent, and a modified location may reflect an implementation choice rather than unique relevance. The verifier scores terminal set overlap and does not execute tests, validate a repair, or judge whether intermediate commands and reasoning were efficient or faithful.

Zero reward is under-specified. The release preserves 8,281 zero-localization-reward rows, but it does not label whether each zero comes from wrong locations, a missing or malformed finish call, turn-budget exhaustion, environment failure, cancellation, or retry. Generator code distinguishes some of these paths and loss-masks maximum-step no-finish rollouts, yet loss_mask, stop_reason, and error category are absent from public rows. A zero therefore cannot be treated uniformly as a semantically wrong search.

Count and group provenance. The 54,845 released rows exceed the paper's nominal direct-RL budget by 3,645. The 14B release contains 160 additional four-attempt groups; the 4B release contains 379 additional groups, and six 4B groups are incomplete with one through six members. No immutable run manifest explains whether these are restarts, retries, resumed training, evaluations, duplicated logging, or valid extra optimizer steps. Analyses must not assume one released row corresponds to one unique planned training rollout.

Configuration drift. The paper specifies four rollouts/four turns for 14B and eight rollouts/six turns for 4B. The inspected scripts default to eight/six for 14B and eight/ten for 4B. Free-form Hydra overrides make paper-matching launches possible in principle, but exact commands and resolved configurations for reported experiments are unavailable. A pinned repository commit is therefore insufficient to recover the paper configuration.

Replay and reward recomputation. Rows contain a task key but omit repository URL, base commit, applied bug-inducing patch, patch-derived gold sets, immutable environment or container ID, generating checkpoint SHA, seed, full sampling settings, logprobs, stop reason, and loss mask. Reward recomputation requires an external join to the processed task artifact; exact trajectory regeneration requires additional unreleased state. The code pins SkyRL and OpenHands SDK revisions, but no end-to-end lockfile/run manifest and no complete training guide were found.

Coverage and contamination. Gold extraction and experiments are centered on Python repositories. The terminal scaffold may generalize, but extraction rules for other languages, build systems, generated code, renames, and cross-language changes are not established. The paper excludes the 128 training repositories from repositories in SWE-Bench Verified, Lite, and Pro-Python, but reports no issue-text, patch/code-content, near-duplicate, or pretraining-contamination audit. Repository-level separation does not settle these broader overlaps.

Reward shaping. The 14B exact-four-turn bonus rewards interaction length independently of localization quality. It may distinguish preferred-length trajectories, but it can also make two equally wrong attempts receive different total training signal. Conversely, a no-finish trajectory at the turn limit is loss-masked even if its search transcript contains useful partial evidence. Without a published top-level total and loss mask per row, downstream users cannot reproduce exposure to all released traces.

Release scope and lineage. The public artifact covers 4B and 14B training rollouts only. Evaluation rollouts are released elsewhere, while the 4K success-filtered 1.7B RFT examples and 1.7B RL rollouts are not mapped into this dataset. The relationship among these releases should not be inferred from model names or shared instance_id strings without an official manifest.

Licensing. The paper is CC BY 4.0 and the code is MIT, but the checked rollout dataset and processed SWE-Smith code-search dataset have no declared dataset license or license file. Rights for upstream repositories, issues, patches, derived targets, and generated chats are not documented as a unified chain. Public downloadability is not authorization for redistribution, commercial training, or derivative release.

The status remains partial. The artifact is unusually useful for inspecting repeated terminal-search attempts and failures, but exact training-set membership, failure causes, experiment configuration, record-level replay lineage, broader contamination, and data reuse rights remain unknown.

代理 target 与 verifier 边界。 gold location 来自修复 patch 所修改的代码。这是可审计代理，而不是“理解该 issue 所需全部代码”的完整定义：必要但未修改的上下文可能缺失，某个修改位置也可能只是实现选择，而非唯一相关位置。verifier 只计算终点集合重叠，不运行测试、不验证修复，也不判断中间命令和推理是否高效或忠实。

零奖励语义不充分。 发布保留 8,281 条零定位奖励行，却没有标注每个零分来自错误位置、缺失或格式错误的 finish 调用、轮数耗尽、环境故障、取消还是 retry。生成器代码区分其中部分路径，并对达到最大步数仍未 finish 的 rollout 做 loss mask；然而公开行缺少 loss_mask、stop_reason 和错误类别。因此不能把所有零分统一解释为语义上错误的搜索。

计数与分组来源。 公开的 54,845 行比论文名义直接 RL 预算多 3,645 行。14B 发布多出 160 个四次尝试组；4B 多出 379 组，且六个 4B 组不完整，成员数从一到六不等。没有不可变 run manifest 说明它们究竟来自 restart、retry、恢复训练、evaluation、重复日志还是有效的额外优化步。分析者不能假设一条公开行就对应一次唯一的计划训练 rollout。

配置漂移。 论文规定 14B 为四条 rollout/四轮，4B 为八条 rollout/六轮。已检查脚本默认值却分别为 14B 八条/六轮和 4B 八条/十轮。自由形式 Hydra override 在原则上可以匹配论文，但报告实验所用的精确命令与 resolved configuration 没有公开。因此，即使固定仓库 commit，也不足以恢复论文配置。

重放与奖励重算。 公开行含 task key，却缺少仓库 URL、base commit、应用的 bug-inducing patch、patch 衍生 gold set、不可变环境或容器 ID、生成 checkpoint SHA、随机种子、完整采样设置、logprob、停止原因和 loss mask。重算奖励需要外部连接预处理任务 artifact；精确再生轨迹还需要更多未发布状态。代码虽然固定 SkyRL 与 OpenHands SDK 版本，但未发现端到端 lockfile/run manifest，也没有完整训练指南。

覆盖与污染。 gold 抽取和实验集中在 Python 仓库。terminal scaffold 可能可以泛化，但其他语言、构建系统、生成代码、重命名和跨语言修改的抽取规则尚未建立。论文从训练的 128 个仓库中排除了 SWE-Bench Verified、Lite 与 Pro-Python 的仓库，但没有报告 issue 文本、patch/代码内容、近重复或预训练污染审计。仓库级分离不能解决这些更广泛的重叠。

奖励 shaping。 14B 的精确四轮 bonus 独立于定位质量奖励交互长度。它可以区分偏好长度的轨迹，也会使两个同样错误的尝试获得不同训练信号。相反，达到轮数上限而未 finish 的轨迹会被 loss-mask，即使其搜索 transcript 含有有用的部分证据。没有逐行公开顶层总奖励与 loss mask，下游用户就无法复现所有公开轨迹实际受到的训练暴露。

发布范围与谱系。 公开 artifact 只覆盖 4B 和 14B 训练 rollout。evaluation rollout 在别处发布，而 4K 条成功筛选的 1.7B RFT 样本及 1.7B RL rollout 没有映射到本数据集。缺少官方 manifest 时，不能仅凭模型名称或共享 instance_id 字符串推断这些发布之间的关系。

许可证。 论文为 CC BY 4.0，代码为 MIT；但已检查的 rollout dataset 和预处理 SWE-Smith code-search dataset 都没有声明数据许可证或 license 文件。上游仓库、issue、patch、衍生 target 与生成 chat 的权利没有形成统一文档链。公开可下载并不等于获准再分发、商业训练或发布衍生数据。

条目状态保持 partial。该 artifact 对审查多次终端搜索尝试与失败样本很有价值，但精确训练集成员关系、失败原因、实验配置、记录级重放谱系、更广泛污染与数据复用权利仍为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, CodeScout is a strong example of a release where the unit of analysis is not just a prompt–answer pair but an attempt inside a task-step group. The instance_id, step, and rollout_number fields let researchers reconstruct most 4- or 8-way groups and study how terminal-search behavior varies under the same task and policy-update context. Mixed and all-zero groups are particularly useful because they expose information normally discarded by best-only curation.

Practical research uses include:

  • comparing commands, observations, finish schemas, and localization components between positive and zero-reward siblings;
  • studying whether file-level success precedes or substitutes for module/entity localization, using the three decomposed F1 fields rather than one opaque total;
  • measuring how group outcome composition changes with training step, while treating checkpoint identity and exact on-policy age as unavailable;
  • testing alternative selection policies over complete attempt groups, including the bias introduced by dropping zero-reward rows;
  • building failure taxonomies for invalid finish calls, budget exhaustion, wrong localization, and environment faults once missing stop/error labels can be recovered;
  • auditing whether an exact-turn bonus changes interaction length independently of search correctness;
  • using the paper–release count mismatch, incomplete 4B groups, and script drift as a reproducibility case study for rollout manifests.

For agent training, the release can support offline inspection, trace featurization, or research prototypes in SFT/RLVR only after data rights and leakage risks are reviewed. A trace's zero or positive terminal reward is evidence about patch-location overlap, not a universal preference label. Directly converting all positive rows to preferred answers would ignore partial scores, task difficulty, policy version, group context, and the fact that the verifier does not validate a repair.

For verifier research, the decomposed schema enables controlled comparisons among file, module, and entity targets. A follow-up release could join each row to gold sets and exact repository state, allowing reward recomputation, alternative hierarchy-aware metrics, and audits of patch-derived target omissions. Until then, the current artifact supports analysis of recorded scores but not independent validation of every score.

For evaluation, the paper's SWE-Bench localization surfaces can test search policies, but training and evaluation releases must remain separate and repository-level non-overlap must be preserved. Performance should be reported alongside success/zero rates, complete-group counts, command and turn budgets, unique task counts, and invalid-finish/error categories. Benchmark improvement alone cannot establish that a rollout release is complete, uncontaminated, licensed, or replayable.

The appropriate reuse class is strong audit and recipe reference; conditional research analysis; training-data redistribution blocked pending license and lineage review. Before broader reuse, require an exact run manifest explaining 54,845 versus 51,200, a per-group completeness record, paper-matching launch configurations, row-level environment/checkpoint lineage, explicit dataset licenses, and a mapping for excluded 1.7B artifacts.

对于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，CodeScout 是一个典型发布：分析单位不只是 prompt–answer pair，而是 task-step 组中的一次 attempt。instance_id、step 和 rollout_number 使研究者能够重建大多数四路或八路分组，并研究同一任务与策略更新上下文中的 terminal-search 行为差异。mixed group 与全零组尤其重要，因为它们公开了 best-only 整理通常会丢弃的信息。

具体研究用途包括：

  • 比较正分与零奖励同组轨迹中的命令、observation、finish schema 和定位分量；
  • 使用三个分解的 F1 字段，而不是一个不透明总分，研究文件级成功是否先于或替代 module/entity 定位；
  • 测量分组结果构成如何随训练 step 变化，同时明确 checkpoint identity 与精确 on-policy age 不可用；
  • 在完整 attempt group 上测试不同选择策略，包括删除零奖励行所带来的偏差；
  • 在补齐停止/错误标签后，为无效 finish、预算耗尽、错误定位和环境故障建立失败分类；
  • 审计精确轮数 bonus 是否在搜索正确性之外独立改变交互长度；
  • 把论文—发布计数差异、不完整 4B 分组和脚本漂移作为 rollout manifest 的复现案例。

对于 agent training，只有在审查数据权利和泄漏风险后，该发布才可用于离线检查、轨迹 featurization 或 SFT/RLVR 研究原型。轨迹的零分或正分只证明其与 patch location 的重叠程度，并不是通用 preference label。直接把所有正分行都转为 preferred answer，会忽略部分分数、任务难度、策略版本、分组上下文，以及 verifier 不验证修复这一事实。

对于 verifier 研究，分解 schema 支持文件、module、entity target 之间的受控比较。后续发布如果把每行连接到 gold set 和精确仓库状态，就能重算奖励、测试层级感知替代指标，并审计 patch 衍生 target 的遗漏。在此之前，当前 artifact 支持分析已记录分数，却不能独立验证每个分数。

对于评估，论文中的 SWE-Bench 定位表面可用于测试搜索策略，但训练与 evaluation 发布必须保持分离，并维持仓库级无重叠。报告性能时还应同时给出成功/零分比例、完整分组数量、命令与轮数预算、唯一任务数，以及无效 finish/错误类别。benchmark 提升本身不能证明 rollout 发布完整、无污染、有许可或可重放。

适当的复用等级是：强审计与配方参考；有条件的研究分析；训练数据再分发在许可证与谱系审查完成前受阻。更广泛复用前，应要求解释 54,845 对 51,200 的精确 run manifest、逐组完整性记录、匹配论文的启动配置、记录级环境/checkpoint 谱系、明确数据许可证，以及被排除 1.7B artifact 的映射。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1–3.4 together: task filtering and patch-derived targets define what the terminal F1 means; the OpenHands-Bash scaffold defines the observable trajectory; asynchronous GSPO defines how the grouped rows enter training.
  • Keep three artifacts separate: the 54,845-row public release covers direct CodeScout-14B/4B training rollouts; the 4K perfect-score 1.7B RFT set is a separate filtered pool; evaluation rollouts are released outside this dataset.
  • Audit groups, not only rows: 14B has 9,760 complete four-attempt groups; 4B has 1,973 complete eight-attempt groups and six incomplete groups of sizes 1–6; 2,317 groups mix zero and positive outcomes.
  • Reconcile the paper's nominal 51,200 rollouts with the released 54,845 and the paper's four/four 14B and eight/six 4B settings with current script defaults before claiming reproduction.
  • Treat reward and rights conservatively: F1 validates patch-location overlap rather than repairs or intermediate reasoning, and the public rollout/task data licenses plus row-level repository/checkpoint lineage are unknown.

• 应把第 3.1–3.4 节连起来阅读：任务筛选与 patch 衍生 target 决定终点 F1 的含义；OpenHands-Bash scaffold 决定可观察轨迹；异步 GSPO 决定分组行如何进入训练。
  • 必须区分三类 artifact：54,845 行公开发布覆盖直接 CodeScout-14B/4B 训练 rollout；4K 条满分 1.7B RFT 是独立筛选池；evaluation rollout 在本数据集之外发布。
  • 审计应以分组为单位，而不只看行：14B 有 9,760 个完整四次尝试组；4B 有 1,973 个完整八次尝试组，以及六个大小为 1–6 的不完整组；合计 2,317 个组同时含零分与正分结果。
  • 在声称复现前，应协调论文名义 51,200 条 rollout 与公开 54,845 行，并协调论文的 14B 四条/四轮、4B 八条/六轮设置与当前脚本默认值。
  • 奖励与权利都应保守解释：F1 验证 patch location 重叠，不验证修复或中间推理；公开 rollout/task 的数据许可证和记录级仓库/checkpoint 谱系仍为 unknown。

title: Citation
引用

value.html: Python issue-localization tasks processed from SWE-Smith. The paper reports a filtered pool of about 39K instances across 128 repositories; the pinned official processed task artifact has 39,287 rows. Each task supplies an issue description, repository state, and gold-patch-derived file, module/class, and function/method targets. The rollout release contains subsets encountered during the 14B and 4B RL runs rather than all source tasks.

One released row contains an instance ID, training step, rollout number, structured chat messages and tool definitions, and a reward dictionary. The chat preserves terminal commands, tool observations, and any final LocalizationFinish call whose locations are objects with required file and optional class_name/function_name fields.

Current-policy CodeScout agents sampled online during RL: Qwen3-14B with thinking disabled and a modified chat template, and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. The public rollout artifact has no 1.7B configuration. CodeScout-14B separately acts as the trajectory generator for the paper's success-only 1.7B rejection-sampling warm start.

OpenHands-Bash exposes a Unix terminal with standard repository-search utilities, including ripgrep, over a cloned pre-PR Python repository. For SWE-Smith, the bug-inducing patch is applied to construct the faulty state. Repository dependencies are not installed and tests are not executed because the task is localization, not repair. A structured LocalizationFinish tool terminates and submits predicted locations.

A valid structured terminal prediction is compared with gold patch-derived sets at file, module/class, and function/method granularity. The three F1 values are summed, yielding a localization reward in [0,3]. CodeScout-14B adds a separate binary reward equal to 1 only for exactly four turns. Missing, duplicated, malformed, or otherwise invalid finish calls receive zero localization reward; no learned or human judge is used.

Success is graded when the agent calls LocalizationFinish exactly once with parseable existing relative locations; each submitted set is scored against patch-derived gold locations. A trajectory that exhausts the turn budget without a valid finish call receives zero reward and is masked out of the policy loss, although its zero-reward trace can remain in the public release.
Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3-14B for direct RL; Qwen3-1.7B is first warm-started by rejection-sampling fine-tuning and then trained with RL.

No teacher generates the direct 4B/14B online RL rollouts. CodeScout-14B generates a separate 1.7B RFT pool: rollouts over 7.7K tasks are filtered to 4K trajectories with perfect file, module, and function F1.

An asynchronous SkyRL/OpenHands generator clones or constructs the repository state, prompts the current policy to search using terminal commands, enforces a structured finish action, computes localization rewards, and logs full chats. Training permits trajectories from checkpoints up to four optimizer steps stale.

Paper-side CodeScout-14B samples four rollouts for each member of a batch of 32 over 300 steps; CodeScout-4B samples eight per member of a batch of eight over 200 steps. Both use temperature 1.0. The release preserves 9,760 four-attempt 14B groups and 1,979 4B groups, of which 1,973 have eight attempts and six contain one through six attempts.
1.0 for all reported RL training rollouts

Task curation discards issues whose pull requests create or delete files, ignores non-Python files in target extraction, drops empty issue descriptions, and excludes the evaluation repositories. The public 4B/14B rollout release is not correctness-filtered: it retains 8,281 zero-localization-reward rows as well as positive attempts. Only the separate 1.7B RFT stage filters for perfect reward at all three granularities.

The paper gives 40K context and six turns for 4B, 50K context with YaRN and four turns for 14B, and 32K context and four turns for 1.7B RL. Released scripts cap generated response tokens at 8,192, but their default turn/rollout values do not reproduce all paper settings. Per-row token counts, seeds, checkpoint identifiers, stop reasons, and logprobs are not released.

Modified asynchronous GSPO in SkyRL with sequence-level importance ratios, no KL or entropy loss, no advantage standard-deviation normalization, AdamW, constant learning rate 1e-6, clip low/high 3e-4/4e-4, one update epoch per batch, maximum policy staleness four, and eight H100 GPUs. The agent scaffold is OpenHands-Bash with Terminal and LocalizationFinish.

The paper's RL training source is a processed SWE-Smith pool of about 39K Python issue tasks from 128 repositories. The rollout release has two policy configurations: 39,040 CodeScout-14B rows from 9,760 unique task IDs and 15,805 CodeScout-4B rows from 1,640 unique task IDs. Evaluation trajectories and the separate 1.7B RFT/RL data are not part of this artifact.

Two single-file train splits only: CodeScout_14B/train-00000-of-00001.parquet has 39,040 rows and CodeScout_4B/train-00000-of-00001.parquet has 15,805 rows. These configuration names identify generating policies, not conventional train/validation/test partitions.

The paper states that none of the 128 SWE-Smith training repositories overlap repositories used by SWE-Bench Verified, Lite, or the Python subset of Pro. No broader audit is disclosed for issue-text similarity, patch/code overlap, near duplicates, or model-pretraining contamination.

items: The public total is 54,845 rows, 3,645 above the paper-side nominal 51,200 4B+14B rollouts. The release has 160 extra 14B groups and 379 extra 4B groups; retries, resumes, evaluations, or logging duplication are not documented.
Six 4B instance-step groups are incomplete, containing one, two, three, four, five, and six rows instead of eight, and no error/retry manifest explains the missing siblings.

Current code defaults do not reproduce the paper configuration: the 14B script defaults to eight rollouts and six turns versus the paper's four/four, and the 4B script defaults to ten turns versus the paper's six.

The release preserves 8,281 zero-localization-reward rows (15.10%); this is valuable failure evidence, but absent stop reasons and loss masks make invalid finish calls, budget exhaustion, environment errors, and genuinely wrong localization difficult to distinguish.
Patch-modified locations are only a practical proxy for relevance and can omit unmodified code needed to understand or solve an issue.
Gold extraction and reported experiments are largely Python-specific even though the terminal scaffold itself is language-agnostic.

Exact reward recomputation requires joining the rollout to a separate task artifact because the row lacks gold targets and repository state; exact regeneration additionally lacks checkpoint SHA, seed, and sampling/replay metadata.
The CodeScout-14B turn bonus can reward exact-budget termination independently of localization quality, while no-finish maximum-step rollouts are zero-reward and policy-loss-masked.
Dataset and upstream derivative-data licenses are undisclosed, and the training README remains incomplete rather than providing an end-to-end replay procedure.

value.html: The paper is CC BY 4.0 and the code repository is MIT. The pinned HF rollout release and processed SWE-Smith code-search artifact have no dataset license field or license file, so data reuse terms are unknown. Rights for source repositories, issues, patches, and generated chats are not separately documented.

SWE-Smith issue and bug-inducing patch -> patch parser extracts gold file/module/function targets -> faulty pre-PR repository state -> current-policy terminal-search attempts -> structured LocalizationFinish prediction -> summed terminal F1 and optional exact-turn reward -> asynchronous GSPO update -> logged rollout row. The public row keeps only instance_id as the task join key and omits repository URL/commit, applied patch, gold targets, policy checkpoint, seed, stop reason, loss mask, and immutable environment identity.
